T: Pancakes the size of a hubcap.
D: A lovable slob uncle looks after his brother's three kids for the week.
P: Serve the sweets when Buck flips the giant pancake.
S: Sticky golden caramel popcorn shaped into balls with a pinch of salt, rolled in rainbow sprinkles for a proper kids' birthday party. Pop 100g popcorn kernels in 2 tbsp oil and tip into a big bowl, removing unpopped kernels. Melt 60g butter with 200g marshmallows and 80g brown sugar over low heat, stirring until smooth, then add a pinch of salt. Pour over the popcorn and stir quickly to coat. Let it cool for 2 minutes, then with buttered hands squeeze into 12 balls. Roll in 50g rainbow sprinkles and set on baking paper for 20 minutes.
Buck's night at the bowling alley

Hot crunchy chips smothered in rich beef gravy and melted cheddar, finished with chopped chives and a sprinkle of chicken salt. Bake 1kg frozen chips at 220C for 25 minutes, turning once, and toss with 1 tsp chicken salt. Melt 30g butter, stir in 2 tbsp plain flour for 1 minute, then whisk in 400ml beef stock and 1 tsp Worcestershire sauce and simmer 5 minutes until thick and glossy. Pile the chips onto a platter, scatter with 150g grated cheddar and pour over the hot gravy so the cheese melts. Finish with chopped chives.
M: Uncle Buck cooking for the kids

A big breakfast plate of crispy bacon, pork sausages, fluffy scrambled eggs, hash browns and baked beans with hot buttered toast. Bake 8 frozen hash browns at 220C for 20 minutes. Fry 8 pork sausages over medium heat for 12 minutes, turning. Fry 8 rashers bacon until crisp. Warm a 420g tin baked beans. Whisk 8 eggs with 60ml milk and salt, then cook in 30g butter over low heat, stirring gently, until just set. Toast 8 slices of bread and butter them. Pile everything onto 4 big plates with tomato sauce.
W: Buck flipping a pancake the size of a hubcap

One huge fluffy buttermilk pancake cooked in your biggest pan, piled with butter, maple syrup, sliced banana and crispy bacon bits. Whisk 300g self-raising flour, 2 tbsp caster sugar and a pinch of salt. Whisk in 2 eggs, 400ml buttermilk and 40g melted butter until just combined. Heat a large 28cm non-stick pan over low heat and grease with butter. Pour in all the batter, cover with a lid and cook 10 minutes until bubbles set on top. Slide onto a plate, flip back in and cook 5 minutes more. Top with butter, 100ml maple syrup, 2 sliced bananas and crumbled crisp bacon.
K: Ice-cold milk shaken up with chocolate malt powder and a scoop of ice cream until frothy, served in big glasses with straws. Put 1L cold full cream milk, 6 tbsp chocolate malt powder, 2 tbsp cocoa, 2 tbsp honey and 4 scoops vanilla ice cream in a blender. Blend for 30 seconds until smooth and very frothy. Pour into 4 big glasses. Sprinkle a little extra malt powder over the froth and serve straight away with straws.
